description: Capture the accessibility tree or compare it with the previous session baseline. The result includes refs for semantic interactions; the diff option reports UI changes. interactiveOnly lists only elements you can act on. After an action with settle, take a snapshot only when its diff lacks the next target or did not settle. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

customActions.description: List the custom actions an element merged away, such as a card's reply control. Not invocable: reach the control via its detail screen, a labeled element elsewhere, or its rect. iOS simulator only; costs one accessibility round trip per merged element.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

observeOnly.description: iOS only. Refuse instead of activating or repairing the session app. Reports XCUIApplication state, which does not prove screen ownership (#2696).

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wall-clock time for the snapshot command.

name: snapshot
title: Capture or diff the accessibility tree
